scripts.db:local: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:local 'wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --local --file packages/db/schema.sql'
scripts.db:seed:local: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:seed:local 'npm run seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --local --file packages/db/seed.sql'
scripts.db:reset:local: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:reset:local 'npm run db:local && npm run db:seed:local'
scripts.build:web:only: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run build:web:only 'npm --workspace web run build'
scripts.deploy:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run deploy:dev 'npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --env dev'
scripts.deploy:prod: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run deploy:prod 'PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://technooptimists.org npm run build:web:only && wrangler deploy --env prod'
scripts.db:prod: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:prod 'wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --remote --file packages/db/schema.sql'
scripts.db:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:dev 'wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists-dev --remote --file packages/db/schema.sql'
scripts.db:seed:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:seed:dev 'npm run seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists-dev --remote --file packages/db/seed.sql'
scripts.db:reset:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:reset:dev 'npm run db:dev && npm run db:seed:dev'
scripts.verify:dev: node scripts/verify.mjs --base "${TO_DEV_BASE:?set TO_DEV_BASE to your dev worker url, e.g. in .env}"
scripts.ship: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run ship 'npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrate:prod && npm run deploy:prod && npm run verify'
scripts.ship:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run ship:dev 'npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrate:dev && npm run deploy:dev && npm run verify:dev'
scripts.db:migrate:local: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:migrate:local 'node scripts/migrate-community.mjs local'
scripts.db:migrate:dev: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:migrate:dev 'node scripts/migrate-community.mjs dev'
scripts.db:migrate:prod: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:migrate:prod 'node scripts/migrate-community.mjs prod'
scripts.db:editorial:local: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:editorial:local 'wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --local --file packages/db/editorial-2026-09-11.sql'
scripts.db:editorial:prod: python3 scripts/coordinate.py run db:editorial:prod 'wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --remote --file packages/db/editorial-2026-09-11.sql'
